This was one of nine Republican-held governorships up for election in a state that [[Barack Obama]] won in the [[2012 United States presidential election|2012 presidential election]]. Incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] Governor [[Rick Snyder]] ran for election to a second term in office. As of {{CURRENTYEAR}}, this is the last time a Republican was elected governor of Michigan, and the last time the Republican candidate won the counties of [[Kalamazoo County, Michigan|Kalamazoo]], [[Oakland County, Michigan|Oakland]], [[Clinton County, Michigan|Clinton]], [[Macomb County, Michigan|Macomb]], [[Kent County, Michigan|Kent]], [[Leelanau County, Michigan|Leelanau]], and [[Isabella County, Michigan|Isabella]], and the last time the Democratic candidate won the counties of [[Alger County, Michigan|Alger]], [[Baraga County, Michigan|Baraga]], and [[Manistee County, Michigan|Manistee]].
